name: Postal Address 21
definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services.

MailingIndicator.name: Mailing Indicator
MailingIndicator.definition: Indicates whether mail should be sent to the address.

RegistrationAddressIndicator.name: Registration Address Indicator
RegistrationAddressIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the address is the official address of the party.

CareOf.name: Care Of
CareOf.definition: When the individual resides at another person’s address, the name of the other person.

AddressLine.name: Address Line
AddressLine.definition: Information that locates and identifies a specific address, as defined by postal services, that is presented in free format text.

StreetName.name: Street Name
StreetName.definition: Name of the street or thoroughfare.

BuildingNumber.name: Building Number
BuildingNumber.definition: Number that identifies the position of the building on a street.

BuildingName.name: Building Name
BuildingName.definition: Name of the building or house.

PostBox.name: Post Box
PostBox.definition: Post box number of the addressee within the residential or company building.

SideInBuilding.name: Side In Building
SideInBuilding.definition: Side or wing of the building, for example, ‘wing A’.

Floor.name: Floor
Floor.definition: Floor or storey within the building.

SuiteIdentification.name: Suite Identification
SuiteIdentification.definition: Identification of the suite or apartment.

PostCode.name: Post Code
PostCode.definition: Identifier consisting of a group of letters and/or numbers that is added to a postal address to assist the sorting of mail.

DistrictName.name: District Name
DistrictName.definition: Name of a district, that is, a part of the town or region.

TownName.name: Town Name
TownName.definition: Name of the town or city.

State.name: State
State.definition: Name of the state, county or country sub-division.

MailingIndicatorRule.definition: If RegistrationAddressIndicator is "true" or "1" (Yes), then MailingIndicator must be "true" or "1".
